claims.claim: The current collection catalogue has global definition data and a separate lit-state ledger. Registered material definitions are categorized; produced found items call FoundMe, become actionable/enter warehouse when needed, and mark the catalogue without a second resource charge. A collection mark grants neither method mastery nor actor execution rights.

The collection window displays catalogue names and totals, greys unlit entries, disables their button and shows category/kind unlock text. Lit entries enable detailed tips. Therefore this is a collection metaprogression surface, not evidence of actor-scoped knowledge or spoiler-free discovery.

Collection data loads from a shared /saves/IllHandData.info path and writes its lit/data dictionaries there. Change sets needsave; selected Step flushes after timer>300 dt or fight-map mode, and SaveData supports explicit flush. Personal data was not opened.

A production loop is10,50,-1infinite or0cancel. The queue owns the current batch, asks for real materials, locks them, and removes their counts on first actual Making progress. MaterialWorkPlace turns one Item_Wood into a nominal3Item_RoughWoodBlock per30work, subject to actual worker efficiency; this is30work, not30wall seconds.

At completion, the batch is removed and a remaining finite/infinite batch is queued before the success roll. Thus retry count follows completed attempts, not guaranteed successes. Shortage leaves head work waiting without a MakeItem command, while partial gathered locks are released; removing an unstarted task unlocks gathered items, but removing progressed work does not restore already consumed material in this path.

Current NewNpcUIEvent table WorldSpeed controls current MessageMgr alerts:1calls player Pause;2/3/4requests1/2/3speed. Enemy message6 is warning+WorldSpeed2; Map actual enemy spawn emits it, reducing speed to1. Warning insertion in enabled selected15x mode also pauses. Alerts change attention/time policy, not enemy existence or spent work.

Pause records playerpause or increments nested syspause, sets Runing false, and leaves Unity timeScale1. Step continues only managers with PauseUpdate while not running. System Play decrements its hold and refuses resume while another hold or playerpause remains. Playing scales dt and changes fixedDeltaTime above1x.

Readable timed scripts schedule by World day/second and GameMain.GetNow, execute only after strictgreater-than deadlines, remove waits before callback, and mark file scripts alreadyRun before callback. AlreadyRun/waits are saved through mod callbacks. Lib.Call catches callback errors; no rollback/retry of the removed/marked entry is present in the inspected runner.

English help says fast2is3x. Current handler calls configured MaxSpeed+3, default5x when MaxSpeed2 and ReplaceSpeed3 is not positive; a gated optional top control calls15x. Stored user settings were not inspected, so actual selected runtime speed remains unknown.

Inspected code establishes running live dt calendar advancement. Focus handler adjusts audio/mouse only. This is insufficient to establish closed-game/offline catch-up, background scheduling, or any full ACS offline policy; no such policy is imported into YAIRPG.

original_proposal.candidate: Receipt-bound manual preparation review inside an existing finite work plan
original_proposal.journey: Player accepts a finite known preparation plan. After a real preparation job settles and its own player-known receipt exists, the cursor pauses future reservations and shows the current known readiness/condition quote. Player continues, changes their preparation, or cancels future steps; finished preparation and the ordinary accepted job keep their real terms.
original_proposal.prototype_anchor: One ordinary existing village.measured_pack step spends1ownedlog+2nativecoins over3playedminutes and yields1real surveykit. Review at its actual completion before a second optional batch illustrates the consumer; root may bind a cultivation preparation plan instead. No new native recipe or method selected.
already_delivered: Bounded repeated simulation programs with fresh input previews
Finite command/travel/wait cursors with actual accepted-job receipt
Goal termination and stock reserve hysteresis/batch limit
Mandatory known decision pauses and known information UI
missing_consumers: A retained plan-specific review/acknowledgement step after actual successful settlement; current validateStep only accepts command/travel/wait
A player-qualified receipt guard tied to the accepted job/cause, not a historical completion count or unobserved global log
A fresh continue command that consumes acknowledgement once and re-previews/re-reserves the next existing command only if still eligible
A narrow current-known readiness/condition projection and paused reason/control on existing plan surface
cost_result_consequences: Review/attention pause charges no new resources or game minutes
Every actual prep job uses existing reservations/costs/results; review creates no mastery/material/restock
A later failed job/cancel uses its current declared refund/forfeit policy; no successful-reviewreceipt if actual completion failed
If a condition/offer was already observed before enrollment, it cannot spuriously trigger another new receipt watch
Future step cancellation retains completed preparation; optional cancelling of current work remains existing controlWorkPlan terms
Pause future cursor reservations only; retain the current shared-clock, event-deadline and accepted-job policies. This review must not silently freeze unrelated world time.
original_proposal.compatibility: Keep workPlans1/2and existing absent-state inert. A new step/policy requires an explicit supported schema/revision and validated fields; never append it to already-frozen cursors. No parallel inventory/clock/RNG/save publisher, no new realm/prestige. Sole integrator owns runtime admission.
later_playable_gate: Observe actual paid preparation and one current-job receipt, then manual stop before the next reservation
Unobserved NPC/private notices and old receipts do not reveal labels or fire watch
Continue/cancel/changed eligibility honor current stock/body/conditions and once-only cost/result
Save/reload retains same paused cursor and accepted-job ownership; legacy absence remains inert; save-failure publication retains prior durable state
original_proposal.not_run: No unit/browser/gameplay/save-failure/regression/director suites; no runtime implementation assigned.
original_proposal.disposition: Qualified optional manual review candidate only. Existing wet-condition rejection, stock stop and goal stop are already delivered, so this family need not force an additional implementation packet.
